summary: HTTP client for URLs you do not control: refuses private, loopback and metadata addresses, caps body and redirects, one lookup per dial
use_when: code fetches a URL that a user, a source or a feed supplied
not_for: calls to hosts you control inside your own network: the check refuses them unless AllowHosts lists them
long calls such as a language model: the default timeout is 10 s, so build another client
